question: Where can I locate hotel within 100 kilometers when heading toward Covid Testing (PCR 30 mins), Los Angeles, CA starting at Disney California Adventure, Anaheim, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Disney California Adventure%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Anaheim%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Covid Testing%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Los Angeles%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), target_bearing AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, d.geometry)) AS bearing FROM start_point s, destination_point d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, target_bearing tb WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography, 100000) -- within 100 kilometers (100,000 meters) AND ( -- Calculate the bearing from the start point to the hotel -- and compare it to the target bearing (start to destination) -- using a +/- 45 degree cone. -- LEAST(diff, 360 - diff) handles the wrap-around for angular difference. LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tb.bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - tb.bearing) ) <= 45 );
